name: Muhammad Arslan
title: SQA Engineer
headline: SQA Engineer | Software Quality Assurance | Manual & API Testing | Playwright (JavaScript) | Postman, SQL, Jira | CRM & SaaS Applications
valueStatement: I help engineering teams ship stable, zero-defect releases by catching critical bugs early and automating regression suites.
about: Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Engineer focused on manual testing, API testing, and reliable releases for CRM, SaaS, and AI-powered web applications.

At Hatzs Dimensions, I turn requirements and business workflows into test scenarios, test cases, and actionable defect reports. I work with developers to reproduce issues, verify fixes, and validate applications before releases and client demonstrations.

What I bring to teams: Functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing across end-to-end workflows; API testing with Postman and database validation with SQL; UI/UX, responsive, and cross-browser testing; and high-signal defect reports with reproduction steps, evidence, severity, and business impact.

My project experience includes DealerIQ AI, Befer AI, Leadly.ai, Broker OS, and StephanAI. In one dealership CRM regression cycle, I identified and reported seven defects affecting paperwork, shipment navigation, data accuracy, form validation, and chat filters. I am actively developing Playwright automation skills with JavaScript for end-to-end web and API testing.
